title: Local finite freeness and section comparison for exterior sheafification
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], M a sheaf of modules, U an open, r,n nonnegative integers, and e an isomorphism from M restricted to U to the free sheaf of rank r [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Let E_n be the exterior sheaf of M, namely the sheafification of the presheaf P_n(W)=\bigwedge^n_{O_X(W)} M(W) [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power]. Then E_n restricted to U is isomorphic to the free sheaf indexed by the n-element subsets of Fin(r). Moreover, for every open V contained in U, the sheafification unit P_n(V) \to E_n(V) is bijective. This holds also for n=0, n>r, empty opens, and zero section rings.

source.place: Tag 0BRT (lemma-smooth-proper), determinant inversion, expanded by the coordinate arguments in lem-sc-exterior-dual-local-frames proof steps 1-3. The tag was read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BRT; it uses determinant inversion but does not state this coordinate lemma.

proof.text: Evaluate the free-sheaf cofan on each object W of Over U. Evaluation preserves finite products and is additive, hence preserves finite coproducts. Compare this evaluated colimit with the Finsupp cofan to obtain a basis indexed by ULift (Fin r), whose vectors are the canonical free sections. Reindex to Fin r and pull back through the evaluated frame. Take Module.Basis.exteriorPower n, and use its basis equivalence with the sectionwise basis of the free sheaf indexed by ULift (Set.powersetCard (Fin r) n). The frame basis is natural because canonical free sections are global sections and the inverse frame is a presheaf morphism. Exterior restriction takes each increasing wedge to the increasing wedge of the restricted frame vectors, by PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower_map_ιMulti. Check the coordinate equivalences commute with restriction on these exterior basis vectors, then apply PresheafOfModules.isoMk. This directly gives the restricted presheaf isomorphism without determinant coordinate calculations.

Transport the sheaf property of the finite free sheaf across the presheaf coordinate isomorphism. The underlying abelian presheaf map of the module sheafification unit is toSheafify, hence locally injective and locally surjective. Restriction along Over.forget U preserves both properties: this functor is cocontinuous for the over topology, and Mathlib Presheaf.isLocallyInjective_whisker and isLocallySurjective_whisker apply. Regard the restricted unit as a morphism of sheaves of modules using the transported sheaf property. Its underlying morphism of abelian sheaves is an isomorphism by Sheaf.isLocallyBijective_iff_isIso; reflect this isomorphism through SheafOfModules.toSheaf. Compose the inverse unit with the coordinate isomorphism and lift through SheafOfModules.fullyFaithfulForget to get the asserted sheaf isomorphism. Evaluate the restricted unit at Over.mk g for every V → U; the evaluated isomorphism is precisely the original unit at V, so ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective gives the second conclusion. The same construction covers n=0, n>r, empty opens and zero rings.

proof_origin.place: S3 stage-3 proof, 2026-10-13: the original two-step route, with naturality checked on increasing exterior basis vectors instead of determinant coordinates, and local unit comparison proved using cocontinuous restriction of locally bijective maps. Increasing-wedge basis read in Stacks algebra.tex, Tag 00DM, section-tensor-algebra; Tag 0BRT remains the motivating determinant inversion. K5 retirement, 2026-10-20: same coordinate proof in the official upstream module; the pure-wedge restriction formula now uses PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower_map_ιMulti. The separate compatibility lemmas identify the two exterior-power constructions for existing callers.

lean.statement:
theorem exteriorSheaf_local_free_comparison (X : Scheme.{u}) (M : X.Modules)
    (n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens) (r : ℕ)
    (e : M.over U ≅ SheafOfModules.free (ULift.{u} (Fin r))) :
    Nonempty ((exteriorPower M n).over U ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (ULift.{u} (Set.powersetCard (Fin r) n))) ∧
    ∀ (V : X.Opens) (g : V ⟶ U),
      Function.Bijective
        (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).unit.app
          (_root_.PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (R := _) M.val n)).app (op V))
